summary: Create the automation hub offline token on console.redhat.com under Automation Hub > Connect to Hub > Offline token > Load Token, copy it and store it securely; it expires after 30 days of inactivity and is used by ansible-galaxy to download or upload collections.
questions: How do I get an offline token for automation hub?
When does the automation hub offline token expire?
Where is Connect to Hub on console.redhat.com?
